title: Phase-selected register value
statement: Let a counting-algorithm state have window radius $s$ and halving count $lg$, and let $ph$ be Boolean. The register vector entry at the index selected by $ph$ is $s$ if $ph$ is true and $lg$ if $ph$ is false.
replaced:
Let a state have natural-number registers $s$ and $\ell$, and let $b$ be a Boolean
value. The state vector's entry at the register selected by $b$ is $s$ when $b$ is true
and $\ell$ when $b$ is false.
